main.description: The community's public attestation that an account is a member — one record per member, keyed by their DID, in the public repo of a discoverable community. Maintained by the host from the members space: written when a membership appears, deleted when it goes. The private membership record stays the source of truth (it carries roles; this carries none). It exists so an app that only reads public data can gate on membership — who may submit to a pool, who counts as a member — and so ejection is visible where it matters.
